function: Quantum-enhanced DRL jointly sets user transmit power, bandwidth shares, offloading fractions, local CPU frequency, and caching to minimize an energy-plus-latency cost in a satellite-UAV-RIS network (p. 9).
system: Maritime SAGIN: 10 users, UAV-carried reflecting RIS relay (64 elements), BS with 8 antennas, LEO satellite with 16 antennas, 20 MHz; carrier frequency not given (p. 5, p. 14).
method: Quantum-enhanced DDPG and PPO: higher-order encoding plus parameterized quantum circuits, simulated with TorchQuantum; model-free reinforcement learning, 1000 episodes of 200 steps (p. 11-13).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician fading with free-space path loss (LoS-dominant UCR links, LoS plus NLoS satellite link) and synthetic harbor mobility; no dataset or measurement (p. 6-7).
test_conditions: Training: 1000 episodes of 200 steps (p. 13). Evaluation: average cost vs bandwidth, task size, task complexity, users; training per setting not stated (p. 14-16).
baselines: Learned only: conventional DDPG and PPO; no non-learned baseline such as random, greedy, or optimization (p. 14-16).
metrics: Reward and average system cost, a weighted sum of energy consumption and latency (p. 8, p. 14-16).
complexity: Analytical order: total O(ET[Bn(L(3n-1)+Nshot+dc+dd+1)+Na+Nc]) for QEDDPG and a similar order for QEPPO; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 13).
q1_support: p. 6: "We employ a Rician fading model combined with free-space path loss"; p. 7 uses free-space path loss for the satellite link. This is a custom simulator, and no 3GPP model, public ray tracing, or measurement is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 15: "we compare the average cost across different numbers of users in Fig. 7". The paper only varies system parameters and never says that an agent trained under one setting is tested on another, so it is not met.
q3_support: p. 14: "in comparison with conventional DDPG and PPO algorithms". Figs. 3-7 show only PPO, DDPG, QEPPO, QEDDPG, so the learned comparison exists but no non-learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 13: "the total complexity can be calculated as O(ET" for QEDDPG, and a similar order for QEPPO, in Section III-F, Complexity Analysis.
q5_support: p. 13: "We carried out simulations using the TorchQuantum" library; no code or data link is given and the environment is a custom simulator, not a public channel dataset.
notes: Title page 1 matches the DOI. Included because the agent learns user transmit power Pm(t) and bandwidth share beta_m(t) (action space, p. 9) jointly with offloading and caching on satellite and UAV-RIS aerial links, which the instructions treat as physical layer; area 6 (power and resource control for satellite and aerial links). RIS phase shifts are not in the action space (p. 9), so not area 3. Carrier frequency has only the symbol fc (p. 6) and no value in Table II (p. 14). Possible borderline: offloading and caching dominate the cost, so a reviewer may weigh above_phy; the explicit joint-decision rule is why it passes.
